requirements.criterion: Profile, catalog, installed skills and bridges agree and reject unauthorized additions.
Historical recovery and current succession reject corruption, deletion and unreviewed edits.
Fast and integration groups retain complete coverage with measured timings.
Clean packages exclude nested Git directories/worktree files and preserve governance validation.

evidence.observed_result:
# Current criterion review

New independent export: 944 manifest entries matched copied bytes. No Git path
components or product-local-task-ui records; no publication. All five checks passed.
AC-01: profile checker plus unauthorized-skill and mismatched-bridge mutation tests.
AC-02: recovery observes 485 preserved files and 439 layout inputs; corruption,
deletion and invalid predecessor/scope tests reject mutations.
AC-03: all 34 discovered tests executed; timing record identifies each group and
measures each case. Groups retain union coverage. Concurrent local checks mean
these timings do not support a comparative speedup claim.
AC-04: export manifest verified independently; Git directory/worktree exclusion and
recursive archive adversarial tests passed, as did checks in the independent copy.
Metadata AC-01/02: four MetadataInventoryTests compare 30 actual hashes and prior
revisions and reject corrupted/deleted/duplicated/unrelated records.

Changed historical inputs: README, project scope, distribution helper and governance
tests. Methods rerun on the new snapshot, not inherited from old executions. Prior
envelopes and failed exports remain preserved. No product or graphical acceptance.
The frozen exported snapshot predates these acceptance records; it does not certify
later evidence edits. Python isolation hook is a test oracle, not an OS sandbox.
